shortDescription: List and filter on all VPC IPv6 addresses. NOTE: IPv6 VPCs may not currently be available to all users.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of all VPC IPv6 Addresses to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting all VPC IPv6 Addresses.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list all VPC IPv6 Addresses in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order all VPC IPv6 Addresses by.
